_schema: MCP-02 per-department DENY map (master PHASE-07 §3: 'doc'un departman red tabloları').
Transcribed from the architecture doc (bubbly-dazzling-goblet.md lines 39/76): CEO no code MCPs;
Research no payment / no prod-DB write; Sales no prod code; Marketing no GitHub write;
Stripe/DocuSign visible ONLY to finance/legal specialists — every other department denies both.
wise added BESIDE stripe, same privilege class — finance-only, denied everywhere else.
Entry format: '<server>' denies the whole server, '<server>.<tool>' denies one tool (study-card dot-notation).
Denials are hard overrides ON TOP of default-deny grants (policy/grants.json): a grant mistake cannot
resurface a denied server. ⛔ AUTHOR-ONLY: REMOVING or NARROWING any entry here (= privilege widening)
requires a construction-author change (Opus 5 since 2026-07-25, U20) with CEO-visible rationale. Additions (tightening) are allowed.

[FABLE 2026-07-14, E9.5] Re-keyed to the live registry (same event as grants.json). Only slug re-keys and TIGHTENING: social-media joins the marketing/sales no-GitHub class; every new department gets the payment/contract denial set.

[FABLE 2026-07-18, R4.3] TIGHTENING with the free-tranche install: (1) playwright.browser_run_code_unsafe + playwright.browser_file_upload denied for every playwright-granted department — arbitrary in-page JS and local-file upload are exfiltration surfaces; the snapshot/act tool set covers all QA/testing needs. (2) git WRITE tools (git_commit/git_add/git_reset/git_checkout/git_create_branch) denied for engineering — construction-phase K1 rule: repo authorship is Fable-only; runtime agents get the READ set (status/diff/log/show/branch). Revisit when holding-owned product repos (Kelam etc.) get their own write policy.
